analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 탈출 시도했으나 여전히 중립 구간에 머물러 방향성 부재. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 여전히 음수 구간으로 약세 수렴 지속. 5일 저가가 20일 저가보다 높아 Higher Low 패턴 형성 중이나, 거래량 위축으로 신뢰도 하락.
analysis.reasonEn: Wait-and-see stance maintained for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI attempted to exit oversold but remains in neutral territory, indicating a lack of direction. MACD histogram shows improvement but stays negative, continuing weak convergence. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low above the 20-day low, but low trading volume reduces confidence.

[모멘텀 지표]

[지지·저항 구조]

[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 0.43 — 움직임의 신뢰도 하락
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 매수점수 5, 관망 조건 충족
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1,668,000) above SMA5 ($1,570,400), below SMA20 ($1,792,550) and SMA50 ($2,152,046) — short-term trend weakening, mid-term trend declining.
· Below SMA100 ($1,702,468), above SMA200 ($1,192,571) — mixed medium to long-term trend.
· 52-week position 48.6% + current price level historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (33.2 → 44.5) + attempting to exit oversold, entering neutral zone — lack of direction.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-60608.8952 → -8714.4488) + improving diagnosis, remaining in negative territory — weak convergence continues.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $1,792,550) + band width 51.43% — widening volatility zone.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level ($1,246,000) + based on Pivot S2.
· Swing resistance level ($1,995,000) + approaching R1 level.
· 5-day high $1,718,000, 5-day low $1,287,000, 20-day low $1,246,000 → Higher Low formation — recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio 0.43 — reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Zone) + buy score 5, meeting conditions for observation.
